notes: Wiki state as of retrieval (game patch history on wiki runs to 1.2.6, 2026-01-04). Every page in Category:Cards (= every page using Template:Card) is included. Each card has a base version plus two alternative upgrades A and B: base cost/text are top-level, upgrades are in extra.upgrade_a / extra.upgrade_b (cost, text, traits, keywords); top-level cost_upgraded/text_upgraded are null by design. Upgrades without their own cost line inherit the base cost. cost 'unplayable' = Unplayable card. type is null: the game has no native card types. keywords are extracted from the plain text (glossary terms incl. generic verbs Attack/Move/Draw/...). Wiki upgrade-delta markers like '(+1)' are stripped; '(Does not Exhaust when played.)' notes are kept. owner = wiki category ('Basic' cards count as CAT cards in game logic). extra.draftable = appears in a crew member's normal Common/Uncommon/Rare reward pool; generated cards (Chip Shot, Pebble, Load State, Crystal Shard, ...) are owned by the crew member but not draftable. Enemy-only/unobtainable cards are KEPT and marked extra.player_obtainable=false (Missile Swarm: Finale-only; Jupiter Eclipse: removed in 1.0.6). Trash/Corrupted cards are obtainable (enemies, boss artifacts, difficulty, events add them to your deck). The game's enemies have no decks, so there are no other enemy cards. Base game has no Oxidation/Lock-On keywords (Cockpit Lock-On is an artifact).

keyword_glossary.Ace: This ship gains X Evade at the start of its turn.
keyword_glossary.Acid Missile: During the drone turn, sacrifice themselves to inflict 1 Corrode.
keyword_glossary.Armored: Armored parts will take 1 less damage from every attack. They are particularly resistant to multi-hit attacks since the damage reduction is applied to each hit, and 1-damage attacks are completely ineffective.
keyword_glossary.Asteroid: A simple midrow object that blocks shots.
keyword_glossary.Attack: Fire from each active cannon straight up its lane for X damage; hits the enemy part (or midrow object) in that lane, misses on empty space.
keyword_glossary.Attack Drone: During the drone turn, make a 1 damage attack. (Attack Drone Card. Also created by several opponents)
keyword_glossary.Autododge: Right before this ship would be hit by an attack (including drones, but not missiles), the whole ship moves to one space left/right (per variant) of the targeted lane. This status then decreases by 1. Goes away at the start of this ship's turn.
keyword_glossary.Autopilot: After playing the leftmost/rightmost card in your hand, your ship moves left/right X spaces. Goes away at the start of this ship's turn.
keyword_glossary.Boost: The next time this ship gains any status, it gains X more of it, and Boost is consumed. (This doesn't apply when you lose any amount of status, even if it is "gaining" a negative amount.)
keyword_glossary.Brittle: Brittle parts will take double the damage from every attack, which makes them extremely vulnerable to high damage attacks.
keyword_glossary.Bubble: The next midrow object this ship launches gets a Bubble Shield around it. This status then decreases by 1. (If the object natively has a Bubble Shield, this status won't be consumed on it.)
keyword_glossary.Bubble Shield: Protects a midrow object from the first attack that hits it (piercing attacks still destroy it).
keyword_glossary.Buoyant: Buoyant cards start at the top of the draw pile, and will be drawn first at the start of combat.
keyword_glossary.Cannon: Ship part attacks come from; ships like Ares/Gemini have two, only the active one fires (Toggle Cannon / War Mode switch it).
keyword_glossary.Cheap Fix: Temporary cards cost X less energy. Decreases by 1 at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Clean Exhaust: With this status, all cards with Exhaust cost 0.
keyword_glossary.Concussable: Concussable parts will cancel their Intent (if they have one) upon being hit by any attack.
keyword_glossary.Corrode: At the end of this ship's turn, it takes X hull damage. (card text calls it Corrosion)
keyword_glossary.Discard: Move cards from hand to the discard pile (Retain cards survive end of turn but can still be discarded by effects).
keyword_glossary.Discounted: Discounted cards will cost 1 less energy until they're played or until the end of combat, so this is only a temporary trait.
keyword_glossary.Draw: Draw cards from the draw pile (hand limit 10).
keyword_glossary.Draw Next Turn: Draw X more cards on the next turn. (Note that you can't have more than 10 cards in your hand.) Afterwards, this status goes away.
keyword_glossary.Drone Turn: Phase after the player's turn and before the enemy's: drones and missiles act left to right in their lanes (missiles sacrifice themselves).
keyword_glossary.Droneshift: At any time during your turn, you can spend 1 Droneshift to move all midrow objects 1 lane to the left or right.
keyword_glossary.Dual Card: Has two alternative action sets split by a line; the highlighted half is performed when played and you can right-click to switch halves.
keyword_glossary.Endless Magazine: After drawing cards at the start of each turn, draw X Chip Shots.
keyword_glossary.Energy: Spent to play cards; 3 per turn by default, does not carry over between turns.
keyword_glossary.Energy Drone: During the drone turn, shoot a blast that gives 1 Energy.
keyword_glossary.Energy Next Turn: Gain X energy on the next turn. Afterwards, this status goes away.
keyword_glossary.Engine Lock: This ship cannot move at all. Decreases by 1 at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Engine Stall: This ship's next X moves will fail. Decreases by 1 when triggered, and goes away at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Evade: At any time during your turn, you can spend 1 Evade to move your ship 1 lane to the left or right.
keyword_glossary.Exhaust: When you play an Exhaust card, it goes into the exhaust pile instead of the discard pile. Under most circumstances, cards can't be retrieved from the exhaust pile, so they are effectively removed from your deck until the end of combat.
keyword_glossary.Flippable: Flippable cards can be right-clicked to reverse their directional actions from left to right and vice versa.
keyword_glossary.Flux: This ship gains X Temporary Shield whenever it attacks. Decreases by 1 at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Football: Some kind of sporting orb. It's indestructible. Moves left or right when you or the enemy hit it. The distance it moves is equal to the damage it takes.
keyword_glossary.Geode: Whenever these are destroyed by either ship, you gain 1 Shard.
keyword_glossary.Heat: If this ship has 3 or more (4 or more with Next Gen Insulation) heat at the end of its turn, it ship will overheat, taking 1 hull damage and resetting Heat to 0.
keyword_glossary.Heavy Missile: During the drone turn, sacrifice themselves to make a 3 damage attack.
keyword_glossary.Hermes Boots: Whenever this ship moves, it moves an additional X spaces. Goes away at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Hull: Ship health; damage persists between combats, reaching 0 loses the run. Max Hull can be raised by some effects.
keyword_glossary.Infinite: Infinite cards do not discard when played, and will stay in your hand instead. They only leave your hand when otherwise discarded.
keyword_glossary.Intent: Each enemy part telegraphs its action for the turn (attack, shield, launch, status); stun or Concussable hits cancel it.
keyword_glossary.Jupiter Drone: These function as an additional cannon for the player, copying all Attack effects. See Jupiter Drone for details.
keyword_glossary.Launch: Place a midrow object in the lane of your Missile Bay (or offset from it); a launch into an occupied lane damages both objects.
keyword_glossary.Less Energy Next Turn: Lose X energy on the next turn. Afterwards, this status goes away.
keyword_glossary.Lose All Evade Next Turn: Ship loses all of its Evade on its next turn, then this status goes away.
keyword_glossary.Max Shard: Temporarily increases maximum shard count by X, and lasts until the end of combat.
keyword_glossary.Max Shield: Cap on regular Shield; any Shield gained above it is wasted.
keyword_glossary.Midrow Object: Drones, missiles, asteroids, mines etc. in the row between the ships; any attack (even 0 damage) destroys one; they block shots; drones/missiles act in the Drone Turn.
keyword_glossary.Missile: During the drone turn, sacrifice themselves to make a 2 damage attack.
keyword_glossary.Missile Malfunction: This ship's drones and missiles will fire backwards. Decreases by 1 at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Missing: 'X is Missing' status: that crew member's cards still cost energy and keep their traits but have no effect when played; each such play reduces the status by 1, at 0 the cards work again. Inflicted by The Tower's cockpit on a random crew member; CAT's Temporal Anomaly self-inflicts 'CAT is Missing' (Basic cards count as CAT cards).
keyword_glossary.Mitosis: On the start of this ship's turn, it loses X Shield then gains twice the amount of Temporary Shield that was consumed, if any.
keyword_glossary.Move: Card action that instantly moves your ship X lanes left/right (Flippable reverses it); blocked by Engine Lock/Engine Stall. Unlike Evade it is not stored.
keyword_glossary.Overdrive: Adds X damage to each attack this ship makes (this increase is shown visually on cards/intents). Decreases by 1 each turn.
keyword_glossary.Overheat: Ending your turn at 3+ Heat (4+ with Next Gen Insulation): take 1 hull damage and Heat resets to 0.
keyword_glossary.Payback: When this ship is hit by an attack, it attacks back for X damage.
keyword_glossary.Perfect Shield: This ship cannot take any hull damage. Decreases by 1 at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Pierce: Piercing attacks ignore Shield and Armor and destroy midrow objects (even bubbled ones) in one hit.
keyword_glossary.Powerdrive: Adds X damage to each attack this ship makes (this increase is shown visually on cards/intents).
keyword_glossary.Quarry: This ship gains X Shard at the start of its turns.
keyword_glossary.Recycle: When you play a Recycle card, it goes back to the top of the draw pile instead of the discard pile.
keyword_glossary.Reflexive Coating: When a ship part is hit, it temporarily gains Armor until the end of its turn.
keyword_glossary.Repair Kit: When this is destroyed, its destroyer restores 2 hull.
keyword_glossary.Retain: At the end of your turn, Retain cards will stay in your hand instead of being discarded. Keep in mind that they can still be discarded through other means.
keyword_glossary.Rock Factory: At the start of its turn, this ship launches X asteroids out of its Missile Bay.
keyword_glossary.Seeker Missile: During the drone turn, sacrifice themselves to make a 2 damage attack. Cannot miss!*
keyword_glossary.Serenity: Whenever this ship would gain any amount of Heat, it loses 1 Serenity instead.
keyword_glossary.Shaken: Draw X less cards on the next turn. Afterwards, this status goes away. (formerly 'Draw Less Next Turn')
keyword_glossary.Shard: A unique resource for Books, which is spent to play certain actions on her cards. Limited to 3 by default.
keyword_glossary.Shield: Extra hit points in front of Hull that absorb damage first; kept between turns (not combats), capped by Max Shield; ignored by Pierce, Heat/Corrode and self-damage cards.
keyword_glossary.Shield Drone: During the drone turn, shoot a blast that gives 1 Shield.
keyword_glossary.Single Use: Like Exhaust cards, Single Use cards can only be played once, with the difference being that they are permanently removed from your deck once played, and cannot be recovered.
keyword_glossary.Space Mine: When this is destroyed, its destroyer takes 2 damage. (Space Mine Card)
keyword_glossary.Strafe: After every movement this ship makes, it attacks for X damage.
keyword_glossary.Stun: A stunning hit cancels the intent of the enemy part it hits for that turn.
keyword_glossary.Stun Charge: Applies Stun to the next X attacks. (Not consumed if the attack already has Stun by default). Goes away at the end of this ship's turn.
keyword_glossary.Stun Source: Gain X Stun Charge at the start of the player's turn.
keyword_glossary.Survive: This ship will not die when it reaches 0 health; instead, something else will happen, and this status will decrease by 1. (The specific "something" that happens is scripted depending on the encounter.)
keyword_glossary.Table Flip: Any card with directional actions becomes flippable.
keyword_glossary.Temp Payback: When this ship is hit by an attack, it attacks back for X damage. Goes away at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Temp Shield: Shield that lasts only until your next turn; separate from Shield and not capped by Max Shield (Time Stop keeps it).
keyword_glossary.Temporary: Temporary cards only last for one fight, as they are permanently removed from your deck at the end of combat.
keyword_glossary.Time Stop: Other statuses will not decrease or reset over time (except for "Gain/Lose ___ Next Turn" statuses). Temporary Shield will also not reset. Decreases by 1 at the start of the ship's turn.
keyword_glossary.Unplayable: Cannot be played (red line through the cost); leaves hand only at end of turn or via discard/exhaust effects; some have on-draw or in-hand effects.
keyword_glossary.Weak: Weak parts will take 1 extra damage from every attack. Multi-hit attacks are especially effective since the extra damage is applied to each hit.

extra.clarification: Jupiter Drones function as extra cannons for the player. They repeat all of your ship's attacks (including automatic attacks, such as Strafe), and will fire after your cannon(s) (if any) have fired. (To clarify, they only fire once, regardless of how many active cannons your ship has.) They copy all lines on cards played that have on them, and anything to their right (the effects "caused" by the shot directly). They do not copy anything else on the card. For example, if you play Stun Shot, your Jupiter Drones will also stun with their attacks. If you play Block Shot, the Jupiter drones will copy the attack but not the Shield gain. If you play Lunge, your Jupiter Drones will fire after you shift and attack, but they will not themselves shift, only attack. Jupiter Drones do not do anything during the Drone Turn and are unaffected by Radio Control.

cards.name: War Mode
cards.text: Both of your cannons become active. Flipping this card toggles your active cannon. Retains. Temporary. Single Use. Flippable*.

extra.wiki_intro: War Mode is a common Ares card. At the start of each turn, Ares Cannon V2 will give you a copy of this if you do not already have one in hand.
extra.clarification: "Flippable" on this card is only similar from a user interface standpoint to other Flippable cards. In contrast to those cards, flipping War Mode actually has an in-game effect (switching your active cannon) rather than changing the effect of the card once played.

cards.name: Weaken Hull
cards.text: Attack for 2. Ship part hit becomes Weak. Exhausts when played.

upgrade_a.text: Attack for 2. Ship part hit becomes Weak. Move 1 to the right. Attack for 2. Ship part hit becomes Weak. Exhausts when played.

upgrade_b.text: Attack for 2. Ship part hit becomes Brittle. Exhausts when played.

extra.wiki_intro: Weaken Hull is a rare Peri card.
extra.clarification: :1. The status is applied after the hit. For example, if you hit an Armored part, you will deal 1 less damage with this card, and then that part will become Weak for all subsequent hits. :2. If you hit a Brittle part with Weaken Hull or Weaken Hull A, the part will become weak, and no longer brittle.

cards.name: Yellow Card
cards.text: This card is temporary and unplayable. It does nothing other than take up space in your hand as punishment for unsportsmanlike behavior. Although not tied to the card itself, getting 3 penalties will result in the player getting kicked out of the Sports match with no rewards.

extra.wiki_intro: Yellow Card is a temporary card that can be given out as a penalty during the Sports! event. It gets added to your hand whenever you deal damage to the opposing ship. (Only direct hits count. Indirect damage from sources such as Corrosion or Grazer Beam does not apply. Getting multiple hits at once with a card such as Multi Shot will only grant 1 penalty.)
